confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and draught beer anchors rest on several Kaohsiung cost-of-living aggregates that broadly agree but are undated and not July-specific; beer is set slightly above their cluster to allow for restaurant service. Cocktail rests on a few bar and reviewer figures, cross-checked against the local beer relationship. Wine_glass is set from the beer relationship and cross-checked against one wine-shop promotion, since no restaurant glass prices were found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation search or live listing check was done. FX is the latest RBA figure the search surfaced (2026-03-20, rba.gov.au snapshot), not confirmed as the latest for 2026-11-19; unverified third-party figures near 0.70 for late 2026 suggest it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used for food and drink; those anchors are Kaohsiung-specific aggregates. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Taiwanese port city within East Asia, not based on a comparable-city search.
